name: MRT
description: Unifies text-to-layers, image-to-layers, and layer-to-layer editing in a 20B masked-region diffusion model for scalable RGBA asset generation (CVPR 2026).

name: Qwen-Image-Layered
description: Decomposes raster images into variable-length semantically separated RGBA layers for independently editable visual assets (CVPR 2026).

name: LayerD
description: Decomposes raster graphic designs into editable layers through iterative foreground extraction and refinement (ICCV 2025).

name: SAWNA
description: Preserves user-specified negative-space regions during text-to-image generation so downstream text and interface elements can be composed cleanly (SIGGRAPH 2025 Poster).

name: PrismLayers
description: Introduces PrismLayers and PrismLayersPro plus ART+ for high-quality multi-layer transparent image generation from text and layouts.

name: ART
description: Generates variable numbers of transparent image layers from a global prompt and anonymous region layout using an Anonymous Region Transformer (CVPR 2025).

name: LayerFusion
description: Generates harmonized foreground RGBA, background RGB, and composite images jointly using pretrained generative priors (CVPR Findings 2026).

name: TKG-DM
description: Generates foreground content over a controllable chroma-key background without training, enabling clean foreground-background separation (CVPR 2025).

name: LayerDiffuse
description: Adds latent transparency to pretrained diffusion models for single- and multi-layer transparent image generation.

name: PrismLayersPro
description: Provides 20K human-filtered multi-layer transparent images with RGBA layers, captions, layouts, and style labels for layered-generation research.
